global_notes: All percentages are project-internal self-assessments. They are not externally validated, not customer-facing, and do not authorize any external claim.

Reaching 100% on any dimension does not relax any no-go claim. The no-go claims are governed separately (see docs/external_review/no_go_claims.md and docs/validation/internal_vs_external_validation_boundaries.md).
The enterprise_saas_readiness dimension is intentionally low (10%) and has a null target. Reaching it is a multi-year effort and is not the current goal.
Updates to this tracker are normal B-track work. Demotions are encouraged when evidence is found insufficient.

Claude review is separate. The Phase 51N checkpoint includes a Claude review preparation pack on the Agent A side; Claude review itself is handled outside this branch and is reflected in B16 (External Review Closeout Tracker) only as a separate workstream.

The 5 remaining inline hotspots (POST /projects/{code}/save-as; POST /scenarios/{id}/rename; POST /scenarios/{id}/archive; POST /scenarios/{id}/update-overrides; POST /scenarios/{id}/select) are tracked in B17 with expected future Agent A phase numbering 51O/51P/51Q/51R/51S. Future extractions of these routes will be reflected in this tracker as they land.
